abundance.scale: published WT-relative (1 = wild type); no rescaling applied

function.scale: published WT-relative (1 = wild type); no rescaling applied

note: delins variants replace two residues with one, so they SHORTEN the chain by one; they are length-changing variants, not insertions

reasons: only 0.0% of variants fall below the loss-of-function threshold of 0.5: the activity assay has almost no dynamic range for loss of function, so a false-pass rate cannot be estimated from it
nonsense variants score at or above wild type in BOTH assays (abundance 1.0137 vs syn 0.9866; activity 1.511 vs syn 0.9743), so neither readout detects a truncated protein as a loss

abundance and activity are ANTI-correlated here (rho about -0.2 in every class, substitutions included), which is the signature of an overexpression system in which more GRB2 sequesters signalling components and suppresses ERK phosphorylation; this makes the pair unusable as a function-vs-abundance comparison rather than evidence about the proxy question
usable_for_this_question.consequence: GRB2 is reported as attempted and rejected. The conclusion rests on script 46 (four proteins, substitutions), not on this file.
